headline: Pensioners Finally Come Out Ahead of Inflation, and Not by a Little: This Is How Much Extra Money They Keep
summary: Pensioners are unlikely to receive a pension adjustment in November, as inflation will be lower than the increase applied at the beginning of the year. The difference increases their real pension value.
why: Inflation and pension indexation shape household purchasing power and government social spending.
